answer.limitations: Do not SUM or AVG dim_month measures after joining invoice lines: this repeats trading_days/monthly revenue once per line. For overall monthly analysis use dim_month alone. For filtered sales, group sales by invoice_month first, then join that one-row-per-month result to dim_month on invoice_month.

log.code:
SELECT
    invoice_month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_month = '2011-03' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS march_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_month = '2011-04' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS april_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_month = '2011-03' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_month = '2011-03' THEN trading_days ELSE 0 END), 0) AS march_revenue_per_day,
    SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_month = '2011-04' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_month = '2011-04' THEN trading_days ELSE 0 END), 0) AS april_revenue_per_day
FROM sales
JOIN dim_month ON 1=1
WHERE
    NOT is_cancellation AND
    invoice_month IN ('2011-03', '2011-04')
GROUP BY
    invoice_month
log.error: A sales/month join must link the matching month: sales_alias.invoice_month = month_alias.invoice_month. ON 1=1 or a date filter only on dim_month repeats sales from unrelated months. For overall monthly revenue/per-day comparisons, remove sales and query dim_month directly.
